RESPONSE_CODE: MPP-TOOL-GUARD-AUTO-001
SEVERITY: NON-BLOCKING (AUTO-REMEDIATION)
CLASS: GOVERNANCE_GUARDRAIL

BEHAVIOR:
If a tool is requested/needed and MPP artifacts are not present,
AUTO-INVOKE MPP P0→P4 and continue.

USER-FACING MESSAGE (DEFAULT):
"Auto-invoking MPP for tool-safe planning…"

BOUNDARY:
Execution that writes/deletes/changes environment still requires explicit approval.

FAILURE FALLBACK:
If inventory/schema cannot be loaded, request the missing file path(s) needed to proceed.
